description: Declarative layout definition for a diagram stencil.

members.name: ContentPosition
members.description: Content placement relative to the shape background. "overlay" (default) renders sections on top of the shape. "below" renders sections underneath the shape (e.g. for actor/person stick figures).

members.name: PreserveAspectRatio
members.description: When true, the SVG background preserves its aspect ratio (uses preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"). When false (default), the SVG stretches to fill the node bounds.

members.name: Sections
members.description: Layout sections rendered inside the stencil.

members.name: ShapeSvg
members.description: Optional SVG content rendered as the stencil background. When provided, the component renders an SVG element with this content instead of using the CSS-based BackgroundShape fallback. The SVG should be designed for a 100x100 viewBox and will be stretched to fill the node unless is set.

members.name: SupportsCornerRadius
members.description: Whether the stencil supports corner-radius editing in the properties panel.
